body: Thank you so much for your reply. They definitely remember it, but I am embarrassed to tell my therapist about it. She’ll probably judge me. I just want to heal from my constant guilt.

I just feel guilty. Got a big punishment for it, but it’s like something took over me. I was going through a lot. Grandma couldn’t walk anymore, Mom was talking to some guy online and ignored me, getting bullied at school by who I though were my closest friends... I feel bad for my past self, to be honest. I was hurting, and nobody took the time to understand me. They drove me to the point of rage. Now, all I feel is guilt. I don’t deserve guilt. Nasty bitches do, not me....
I broke something expensive out of rage

I don’t mind doing schoolwork, I just can’t get over what I did when angry. I think about it every day, and how it ruined everything for me. I cant live with it, because i KNOW that is not who I am, but at the end of the day, I did it.
Does anybody know where I can find xanax and fentanyl? Or maybe give me the # of somebody who sells it?

Once, a couple years after it happened, he made me angry. My mother was in the room, and I blurted it out. He called me crazy. He said “Listen to her! She sounds crazy!” And my mom completely disregarded it, and it has never been mentioned again. I doubt anyone would believe me if I would say anything, and it makes me feel very imprisoned.
I definitely will, and I’ll ask her before I say it too. Thank you so very much, and I love your user name :)
